description: Enrich companies, search by ICP filters, find lookalikes, or list new registrations using cookieless public sources.

city.description: City to match against the HQ address.
city.title: City

companyNames.description: Company names resolved through Wikipedia/Wikidata and GLEIF. (mode=enrich)
companyNames.title: Company names

companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company, Crunchbase, ZoomInfo or Wikipedia URLs. (mode=enrich)
companyUrls.title: Company profile URLs

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. France, FR, United Kingdom, US. Drives national-registry selection.
country.title: Country

domains.description: Domains to enrich, e.g. stripe.com or siemens.com. (mode=enrich)
domains.title: Company domains

emails.description: Work emails whose company domain should be enriched. Free mailbox providers are skipped. (mode=enrich)
emails.title: Work emails

employeeMax.description: Maximum employee count or band. 0 means no maximum.
employeeMax.title: Employees (max)

foundedYearMax.description: Latest founding year. 0 means no maximum.
foundedYearMax.title: Founded year (max)

hiringNow.description: Keep companies with at least one open role detected on their careers page/ATS.
hiringNow.title: Hiring now only

includeDns.description: MX email provider, SPF/TXT marketing tools, domain creation date and registrar.
includeDns.title: Enrich from DNS/RDAP

includeFunding.description: Sum amounts sold across matched Form D filings and return round details.
includeFunding.title: Enrich with SEC Form D funding

includeHiring.description: Detect Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio and other ATSs and count open roles.
includeHiring.title: Detect ATS and open jobs

includeLinkedIn.description: Read the public company page: industry, size, HQ, specialties, followers and similar pages.
includeLinkedIn.title: Enrich from LinkedIn public page

includeNews.description: Recent Google News RSS items mentioning the company.
includeNews.title: Add recent news

includeOwnership.description: Fetch direct and ultimate parent LEI records from GLEIF.
includeOwnership.title: Resolve GLEIF parents

includeRegistry.description: GLEIF LEI plus France/UK/Norway registry detail where available.
includeRegistry.title: Enrich from public registries

includeSec.description: CIK, SIC, filings, reported revenue and employees for SEC registrants.
includeSec.title: Enrich from SEC EDGAR

includeTech.description: Detect CMS, analytics, CRM and marketing tools from page source.
includeTech.title: Detect technology fingerprints

includeWebsite.description: Parse schema.org, meta tags, contact/about pages, social links, diagnostics and ATS links.
includeWebsite.title: Enrich from company website

includeWikidata.description: Founding date, employees, revenue, parent, subsidiaries, CEO, ticker and official website.
includeWikidata.title: Enrich from Wikidata/Wikipedia

industryKeywords.description: Industry words, e.g. software, fintech, logistics.
industryKeywords.title: Industry keywords

legalForm.description: Legal form text, e.g. GmbH, SARL, Ltd, LLC.
legalForm.title: Legal form

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted company records.
maxItems.title: Max companies

minSimilarity.description: Lookalike score threshold (0-100): industry 40, size 20, country 15, tech 10, founded 5, keywords 10. (mode=lookalike)
minSimilarity.title: Minimum similarity score

enumTitles: Enrich companies (domains, emails, names, profile URLs)
mode.title: Mode

naicsCodes.description: NAICS codes or prefixes (e.g. 5415, 52). Mapped to registry queries and SIC filters.
naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes

raisedFundingRecently.description: Keep companies with a recent SEC Form D filing.
raisedFundingRecently.title: Raised funding recently

region.description: Region, state or province to match against the HQ address.
region.title: Region / state

registry.description: Registry used by ICP search and new-registration mode. auto picks FR/NO/UK/US sources where available, otherwise GLEIF.
registry.title: Registry source

seedDomains.description: Companies to find lookalikes for, e.g. stripe.com. (mode=lookalike)
seedDomains.title: Seed domains

sicCodes.description: US/UK SIC codes used by SEC and Companies House searches.
sicCodes.title: SIC codes

technology.description: Keep companies whose website fingerprints include this technology, e.g. Shopify.
technology.title: Uses technology

title: Company Intelligence Finder Input
